purpose: Teach: 共鳴/下院/壊滅/縄文/半減/弾道/受益/書簡

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、共鳴する目撃証言を警察、集めております
lines.en: We're currently gathering corroborating witness statements on this case.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Steady cadence—each phrase lands with quiet authority. Professional composure, not rushed. The voice of someone accustomed to briefing people.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、政府下院の指示で警察、対応されたんですね
lines.en: So the police responded to this under government direction, then?
lines.style: Genuine inquiry, slightly formal to match the official context. Thoughtful pause before the question. Respecting the authority but genuinely curious about the chain of command.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、台風で壊滅した地域の救援活動も行います
lines.en: The police are also conducting rescue operations in the areas devastated by the typhoon.
lines.style: Factual, matter-of-fact delivery. Slight weight on the scope of the work. Steady pacing—this is routine operational information, stated clearly without drama.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、縄文遺跡からの盗掘事件を警察、捜査中ですね
lines.en: So the police are currently investigating the looting case at the Jomon ruins, I understand?
lines.style: Thoughtful and slightly deferential. Soft confirmation seeking—not interrogative, more like checking understanding with respect. Small grateful undertone for the information shared.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪件数が半減した地区を集中支援しております
lines.en: We're concentrating support efforts in districts where crime rates have dropped by half.
lines.style: Calm, informative delivery. Even pacing throughout. Slight emphasis on the positive metric—data-driven and confident. The tone of someone reporting measurable success.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、不正な弾道計算を警察、暴いたんですね
lines.en: So the police uncovered falsified ballistic calculations in this case, then?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly impressed undertone. Gentle questioning, as if processing the significance of the discovery. Respectful pause before speaking, registering the sophistication of the evidence.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、受益者の保護を進めております
lines.en: We're advancing the protection of the people who benefited from this.
lines.style: Measured, official phrasing. Steady voice—this is progress being reported, not urgency. Slight formality in word choice. The composure of institutional commitment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、犯人の書簡を警察、押収されたんですね
lines.en: So the police seized the suspect's correspondence from this case, is that right?
lines.style: Quiet understanding, almost to himself. Reflective close—acknowledgment of the breakthrough. Soft fade on the confirmation, like he's finishing a thought he's been holding.
